caption:
Poland signs $300 million Palantir deal to use AI in defense

Palantir Technologies · Business

The software will analyze battlefield data, and some European allies are pushing to cut reliance on US technology. Palantir Technologies Inc. supplies the artificial intelligence-based software under the contract. The minister made the remarks while defending the deal against concerns over reliance on American technology.

Reported by Politico Europe; Bloomberg; CNA.
